name: DeductGlass
subtitle: Receipts & tax estimates
promotionalText: Organize business-expense evidence and compare illustrative tax methods before professional review.
description:
Organize business-expense evidence and compare illustrative tax methods before professional review.

Import a receipt, CSV or text, review the source facts and mark evidence as checked.

Keep business-purpose notes with expense records and export a selected-year evidence binder or spreadsheet CSV.

Compare US mileage and home-office methods using explicit year, distance and cost assumptions.

Use a separate Singapore recordkeeping workspace; US deduction formulas do not apply to that export.

Search your saved library locally. Export a complete portable backup with optional password encryption; imports add new identifiers and keep existing edited records.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Document processing and supported Apple Intelligence generation run on device. Optional storage uses your private iCloud container. There is no developer-operated account, advertising, analytics backend or third-party AI API. Supported local/text workflows remain available when a model or speech language is unavailable.

FREE AND PRO
Includes five successful on-device AI actions in total per app. Reading, editing, exporting and backing up saved records remain available without Pro. Pro unlocks additional actions through monthly or annual subscriptions, or a separate lifetime purchase. App Store prices, eligibility and subscription terms are displayed before purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled in App Store settings.

Estimates are not tax advice, a filing service or a deduction guarantee. Eligibility, income limits, carryovers and local rules require qualified review. Stored amounts are USD; no currency conversion is performed.
